personas.label: The AR Poster Maker
personas.oneLine: A zine maker who turns 5-second WebM clips into shareable markerless AR stickers that print on demand.

personas.label: The Storyboard-First Editor
personas.oneLine: A music video editor who treats bar-aligned auto-edits as a starting point and re-cuts the first chorus by hand.

personas.label: The Variant Collector
personas.oneLine: A creative coder who treats the 27 visual variants as a palette of moods and A/B tests them against a single track.

personas.label: The FX Surgeon
personas.oneLine: A colorist who treats the 14-FX pipeline as a single WebGL fullscreen quad and pushes every uniform to its limit.

personas.label: The Transition Choreographer
personas.oneLine: A motion designer who treats the 10 CSS transitions as a vocabulary and writes scene changes by hand on the bar grid.

personas.label: The Export-First Renderer
personas.oneLine: A working animator who treats the engine as a render farm that outputs WebM via MediaRecorder and converts to MP4 with ffmpeg.

personas.label: The Anchor-Map Curator
personas.oneLine: A label A&R who curates the 19 anchor presets by hovering the (warmth × intensity) 2D embedding and re-tagging the library to match.

personas.label: The Audio Theorist
personas.oneLine: A music theorist who reads the BPM, key, and chromagram as a sonification of theory and uses the engine to make the analysis visible.

personas.label: The Tag Janitor
personas.oneLine: A video editor who curates the library's tag schema so the ShotPicker stops returning traffic clips for tender songs.

personas.label: The Magic-Link Project Saver
personas.oneLine: A touring band's visualist who saves 30 named storyboards per tour via the magic-link login and never trusts a browser session.

personas.label: The AR Poster Artist
personas.oneLine: A visual artist who makes AR posters of their own tracks by compositing a song into the engine, exporting a 5-second WebM, and dropping it into /ar-loop for markerless placement in galleries.

personas.label: The Live VJ
personas.oneLine: A live VJ who builds hour-long sets from the 19 anchor presets and the 10 CSS transitions, recording each set as a WebM for the venue's archive.

personas.label: The Film Composer
personas.oneLine: A film composer who saves a storyboard per cue sheet via the magic-link login and reloads the bar-aligned cuts on every spotting session.

personas.label: The Theory Sonifier
personas.oneLine: A music theorist who sonifies chord progressions by pushing the FX pipeline's chroma uniform on each chromagram peak and recording the visual as a WebM for a paper.

personas.label: The AR Flashcard Educator
personas.oneLine: A high-school biology teacher who makes AR flashcards by recording 5-second WebMs of cell division, looping them via /ar-loop, and firing `whip-blur` between phases.

personas.label: The Short-Film Scorer
personas.oneLine: A short-film composer who authors a named storyboard per cue sheet, locks the variant per cue via the anchor map, and ships the temp reel as WebMs.

personas.label: The Touring-Band Visualist
personas.oneLine: A touring band's stage visualist who picks per-song variants from the 27, fires `glitch-block` on drops, and ships AR merch posters via /ar-loop at the merch table.

personas.label: The Research Data Sonifier
personas.oneLine: A research scientist who sonifies climate data by mapping temperature curves to the FX pipeline's chroma uniform and recording the visual as a WebM for a paper.

personas.label: The Gallery Curator
personas.oneLine: A museum curator who builds an audio-reactive exhibit by compositing ambient tracks into the engine, locking the variant via the anchor map, and shipping AR labels via /ar-loop.

personas.label: The Podcast Visual Editor
personas.oneLine: A podcast editor who makes 10-second visual hooks per episode by mapping the chromagram peaks to library stills and recording the WebM for YouTube Shorts.

personas.label: The Music Therapist
personas.oneLine: A music therapist with non-verbal clients who builds calming visual environments via the anchor map and ships take-home AR loops for the families.

personas.label: The Ad Agency Creative Director
personas.oneLine: An ad agency creative director who authors three anchor-locked variants per brief, fires `flash-cover` between them, and ships client review links via the magic-link login.

personas.label: The Online Music Teacher
personas.oneLine: A music teacher running an online course who builds lesson plans as bar-aligned storyboards, picks the variant per concept, and ships lesson WebMs.

personas.label: The Bedroom Producer
personas.oneLine: A SoundCloud bedroom producer who picks an anchor per track, stacks two loop stills from the library, and records a 30-second WebM for the SoundCloud visual.

personas.label: The Choreographer
personas.oneLine: A choreographer who sonifies the dancers' movements by mapping the chromagram to the FX pipeline's chroma uniform and projecting an AR mirror in the studio.

personas.label: The Wedding Videographer
personas.oneLine: A wedding videographer who authors a 3-minute highlight reel per wedding by stacking ceremony clips, locking the variant via the anchor map, and recording a WebM for the couple.

personas.label: The Album Cover Designer
personas.oneLine: An album cover designer who picks the variant per track, freezes the cover frame at the chromagram peak, and records the still as a PNG.

personas.label: The AR Storyboard Reviewer
personas.oneLine: A film director who reviews the composer's storyboard as a markerless AR loop in the spotting session and records the AR scene as a WebM for the studio's archive.
